purpose: Policy for automatic relay of validated releases from Forgejo (SSOT) to GitHub (public projection).

notes: Tag must be on commit that passed all gates

action.method: force-push allowed on relay (projection, not authority)
action.read_back: verify github/ref matches forgejo/ref after push

stages.name: validate_tag
checks: tag points to commit that passed all release gates

stages.name: relay_push
stages.read_back: verify github tag SHA matches forgejo tag SHA

stages.name: relay_complete
stages.evidence: tag SHA on github matches tag SHA on forgejo
notes: public projection now has validated release

rollback.on_failure: remove tag from github if relay fails after push
rollback.manual_intervention: required for divergent history or force-push of relay

exclusions.no_direct_github_commits: GitHub is relay only. No direct commits, PRs, or mutations from GitHub.
exclusions.no_force_push_without_reason: Force-push to GitHub relay only for valid release promotion, never arbitrary history rewrite.
exclusions.no_public_secrets: No secrets, credentials, or sensitive data in public projection.

rules.rule: Relay to GitHub occurs only when a release tag is created on forgejo/main after all release gates pass.
notes: No relay if gates not passed

rules.rule: After relay push, verify that GitHub tag SHA matches Forgejo tag SHA.
notes: Read-back proof required for relay completion

rules.rule: GitHub is a public projection and relay mirror. It is not the source of truth for CYNIC.
notes: GitHub can be force-pushed for relay but never drives the project

rules.rule: No direct commits, PRs, or mutations originate from GitHub.
